description: Source code for ShippingRule doctype in ERPNext, defining validation, application, and overlap checking for shipping rules.

classes.name: OverlappingConditionError
classes.description: Custom validation error for overlapping shipping rule conditions.

classes.name: FromGreaterThanToError
classes.description: Custom validation error for 'from' value greater than 'to' value in shipping conditions.

classes.name: ManyBlankToValuesError
classes.description: Custom validation error for multiple conditions with 'to' value as zero or blank.

classes.name: ShippingRule
classes.description: Main class representing shipping rules, including validation, application, and overlap detection.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the shipping rule by checking values, sorting conditions, and overlaps.

methods.name: validate_from_to_values
methods.description: Checks that 'from' and 'to' values are non-negative and logically ordered.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the shipping rule to a document, calculating shipping amount based on conditions.

methods.name: get_shipping_amount_from_rules
methods.description: Retrieves shipping amount based on value and conditions.

methods.name: validate_countries
methods.description: Validates if the shipping address country matches the rule's applicable countries.

methods.name: add_shipping_rule_to_tax_table
methods.description: Adds or updates shipping charges in the document's tax table.

methods.name: sort_shipping_rule_conditions
methods.description: Sorts shipping conditions by 'from_value' in ascending order.

methods.name: validate_overlapping_shipping_rule_conditions
methods.description: Detects overlapping shipping conditions and raises an error if found.
